error.title: The interface ran into an error
error.safe: Your files, settings and running tasks are not affected. Try again first; if that does not help, try the other options in order.
error.resetNote: Restoring the default interface only resets the look and layout. No data is deleted.
error.hint: When reporting the problem, please include the error details below.
error.copyFailed: Copy failed. Please select the text and copy it manually

overview.title: TRM UI
overview.whatBody:
TRM UI contains design tokens, base components, interface text in eight languages, a sidebar application shell and a project setup that runs as is.
The src/trm/ folder depends on no product code and can be copied into a new project as a whole.
overview.whyBody:
Every new product starts from the same interface, with the same tokens, components and motion.
Improvements are made here and then synced to each product, rather than changed separately in each copy.
overview.rule1: Colours come only from tokens. A hard-coded colour breaks in the other theme, and the problem shows only when the theme is switched.
overview.rule2: Interface text comes only from the language packs. A build-time check verifies that all eight languages share the same structure.
overview.rule3: src/trm/ does not import code from outside the folder. Once it imports product code, the template becomes part of that product.
overview.themeTip: With "Follow system", the interface switches with the system's light or dark setting.
overview.langTip: All eight languages are built in; the interface text updates as soon as you switch.

shell.title: Desktop shell
shell.web: This is a web preview. Window buttons, the tray and saving settings need the desktop application and are not shown here.
shell.sourceTip: Where the interface files are loaded from. A frontend folder in the program folder replaces the files shipped with the installer, which confirms whether an interface patch has taken effect.
shell.autostartTip: The start-at-login state is read from the system registry, not the settings file, so it stays correct when settings are copied to another computer. Windows only.

components.sub: All controls below can be operated.
components.buttonsNote: While a button is working it shows three moving dots, confirming that the action was received and is in progress.
components.segmentNote: The selected segment is marked by a thumb that can be clicked or dragged.

field.name: Display name
field.nameTip: The question mark is a separate button; clicking it shows the help and does not toggle the setting it sits in.
field.deviceDesc: A saved option that is no longer available is still shown and marked as unavailable.
field.volumeNote: While dragging, the handle follows the pointer; on release it snaps to the nearest step and shows the value actually set.

list.item1Body: A clickable row expands its description when clicked and collapses on a second click. Both directions have a height transition.
list.item2Desc: The right side holds a button, a switch or a status label.

type.sub: Body text is 15px with a line height of 1.65. Only the sizes below are used; no values in between.

color.sub: Every colour has to be checked in both the light and the dark theme.

motion.sub: Curves, names and demonstrations of each motion. Every demonstration can be operated.
motion.easeNav: Page transitions only. It starts fast, ends slowly and never overshoots. The page layer sits flush with the window edge, so an overshoot would show a visible seam.
motion.spring: For small elements. It overshoots, so it is used only on elements that do not touch the window edge, such as the segment thumb and floating panels.
motion.ease: The general-purpose transition. Hover, press, colour changes.
motion.easeSoft: Gentle start and slow settle, for fades and small moves
motion.springSettle: Critically damped spring with no overshoot, for large morphs
motion.springGentle: About 1% overshoot, for page changes and small moves
motion.springBouncy: About 8% overshoot, for small scale changes only
motion.flowSub: A band of light runs along the bottom when a task is done but not yet viewed
motion.nudgeBody: It rises from below when shown; when dismissed its height closes and the content below moves up.
motion.modalBody: It rises and grows slightly when opened, and plays its closing animation before it is removed.
motion.drawerBody: It slides in from the right to show details without leaving the current page.
motion.curvesHint: Click a row to play that curve.
motion.glassHint: Click a segment, or hold the thumb to drag it or throw it towards an end.

patterns.sub: Interface patterns common in desktop applications. All of them can be operated.
patterns.warnLine: Needs 14 GB of VRAM; this machine has 12 GB
patterns.modalText: Click outside or press Esc to close.
patterns.drawerText: Slides in from the right so details open without leaving the page.
patterns.noticeText: Click this notification to see the details.
patterns.pagerNote: Content is pushed in the direction of travel and page numbers slide to their new places.

inter.sub: In-page switching, comments, step guides, prompts, errors, ring charts, panels and a floating button
inter.c1: The instructions are clear; it worked the first time.
inter.c2: On a slower computer it takes a while.
inter.stepBody: Each step does one thing; choose Next when it’s done.
inter.notice1: Report problems on the issue page.
inter.notice2: Generate a diagnostic package and attach it before you submit.
inter.panesNote: Tabs use push; filtering the same list uses the flow list.

set.sub: Three kinds of settings: appearance, general and shortcuts. Labels on the left, controls on the right, notes below. A change that needs a restart shows a bar at the top.
set.wallpaperNote: A still image. Very large images slow down loading.
set.bannerHint: Leave empty to use the default.
set.compatTip: Turn on if the window shows garbled or blank areas. Takes effect after a restart.
set.prewarmDesc: Uses some graphics memory in advance so work can start sooner.
set.statsDesc: Sends only a random anonymous ID, the app version and the hardware acceleration in use. Nothing that identifies you.
set.mouseDesc: Mouse button 4 goes back and button 5 goes forward between the pages on the left.
set.restartBody: Compatible rendering was changed. Restart the app to apply it.
set.keysHint: Click a shortcut, then press new keys. Esc cancels and Backspace clears it. If another action already uses the keys, that action's shortcut is cleared and you are told.
set.globalTip: When checked it works in any app, but no other app can use the keys. When unchecked it works only while this app is in front.
set.moved: {combo} was used for "{from}". "{from}" now has no shortcut.
set.hoverNote: Hover and selection style for text buttons such as comment actions, filters and page numbers.

more.boardSub: Sources on the left, the list in the middle, the selected item's editor on the right, and what is running fixed at the bottom.
more.editNote: Name, number, range and shortcut are all edited in this column; the list stays still while you edit.
more.editEmpty: Select an item in the list to edit it here.
more.effectLogs: Earlier records will be unavailable for troubleshooting
more.effectTrash: Deleted items can no longer be restored
more.effectResume: You can no longer resume from where you stopped
more.effectRedo: You will need to process again from the start
more.starterSub: When there is nothing yet, a few recommendations are offered. A click starts the download, progress shows in place and it can be cancelled at any time.

text.sub: How interface text is written, with a wrong and a right example for each rule.

history.sub: Established designs that have been replaced, newest first.

rules.tipText: Adjusts the volume sent to speakers or headphones.
